commentary_segments.text: All analog circuits are built up by use of a very limited number of elementary building blocks. Thorough knowledge of these simple blocks is therefore essential in obtaining insight into more complicated circuit schematics. This is why they are considered separately and analyzed in great detail. We now have a complete knowledge of single-transistor circuits. Now we will concentrate on the study of current mirrors and differential pair. These form the cornerstone of all analog design.
